name: Troglof
description: The Troglof were a rare sentient species with tentacle-like arms native to Troglofa. A diminutive species, the Troglof had a pleasant natural odor. Troglofs could also move their eyestalks independently. Thamm was a Troglof who worked as a croupier in the Canto Casino in the city of Canto Bight. Another Troglof worked as a spa attendant and waiter at the Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa on Lanupa.
